test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: There are eight people in a family. A is married to C. A has two children, B and E. A is the mother of B and E. B is the wife of L. P is the wife of E. L has one daughter G. E has one daughter K. How is C related to K ?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdba39eb77d5a65b7552dcbdc9aa48e2c366c6356da6ff76c72da57f690390e4.png] 

As per the given information:

1. A is married to C and A has two children, B and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a769cc32912ad1b65636e905390d2e62ac37c17c4b9ff78df2d342ad61e39bd.png] 

2. A is the mother of B and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3370e752775d3692cb18c0b413e81c1c01082a6bc9426fc792081845ffdc9981.png] 

3. B is the wife of L and P is the wife of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a3fa545a8dfb70a48f4b2ab13c5f235f2aaf569fc80b3b96843b50741ab5fc0.png] 

4. L has one daughter G and E has one daughter K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fc63465084da1d75aef8084e1efdab910f2d3bd98a2574487819f6227a5dc40.png] 

Here, C is the father's father of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
